stories.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
stories.description: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

stories.title: U.S. military withdraws from Iraq two decades after invasion
stories.description: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

stories.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
stories.description: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.

stories.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
stories.description: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

stories.title: UK believes Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident, Burnham says
stories.description: The prime minister's comments come days after the suspects were released on the 'strictest possible bail conditions'.

stories.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
stories.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

stories.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
stories.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

stories.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
stories.description: Iran's foreign minister acknowledges Trump's comments, but adds that Tehran is waiting for the "definitive views" of mediators.

stories.title: Miliband tells Iran minister UK will not tolerate 'hostile activity' on British soil
stories.description: The foreign secretary stresses "the UK's unwavering resolve to combat threats from Iranian-linked groups in UK soil, including attacks on the British Jewish community".

stories.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
stories.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

stories.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
stories.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

stories.title: Who are the Houthis and what do they want?
stories.description: A rapid military advance down Yemen's Red Sea coast has put the spotlight on the Iran-backed group, amid growing concerns about the global energy market.

stories.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
stories.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

stories.title: Watch: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran if no deal reached
stories.description: US President Donald Trump presented Iran with a stark choice: reach an agreement or face the rapid “annihilation” of the Islamic Republic.

stories.title: Why is the US withdrawing its troops from Iraq?
stories.description: A US-led coalition deployed in Iraq more than a decade ago to fight jihadists concluded its mission on Wednesday, a move celebrated by the country's leaders, but which some fear will embolden pro-Iran armed factions. stories.title: Medicine prices soar in Iran as US blockade and sanctions hit hard
stories.description: Medication prices are soaring in Iran and some treatments have become hard to find, leaving patients and their families scrambling as a US blockade and stepped-up sanctions squeeze the country's pharmaceuticals industry.

stories.title: Strong indications’ Iran linked to suspected UK airbase plot
stories.description: UK Prime Minister says there are ‘strong indications’ Iran played a part in the suspected RAF Fairford airbase plot.

stories.title: Why is Malaysia sending back Rohingya refugees to Myanmar?
stories.description: Kuala Lumpur calls it a voluntary process, but many are raising safety concerns.

stories.description: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has said that Pakistan was “there to help” Saudi Arabia in any conflict. “We are there to help Saudi Arabia in any conflict, whether it is coming from the Houthis or a country or any other outfit that threatens Saudi Arabia’s security. stories.description: A UK probe into a suspected bomb plot at an airbase used by the United States was mired in confusion, as police said no explosives but a “quantity of petrol” was found in vehicles seized nearby. stories.description: A US-led coalition deployed in Iraq more than a decade ago to fight militants concluded its mission on Wednesday, a move celebrated by the country’s leaders. stories.description: US forces are set to withdraw on Wednesday from their last bases in Iraq, a departure celebrated as a victory by Iran and its allies, which have deep influence in the country where 4,500 Americans died during more than two decades of war. stories.description: JALUD: More than 100 Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank on Tuesday, drawing rare Israeli government condemnation after they injured three members of the security forces. stories.title: 23 years after invasion, U.S. leaves Iraq; Iran stays
stories.description: The U.S. invasion of Iraq in 2003 was its second target in its ‘war on terror’. But its war against Iran now has made it increasingly difficult for the United States to keep a large group of troops in a region that’s turning hostile.

stories.title: U.S. military says its withdrawal of troops from Iraq complete
stories.description: Iran, which says its ultimate aim is to force American forces to leave the entire West Asia, casts the U.S. withdrawal from Iraq as a victory for its “axis of resistance” of allied armed groups across the region

stories.title: Iran receives U.S. feedback on seven-day trust-building plan

stories.title: Iran retaliates after Israeli strikes its nuclear program; 3 killed, several wounded
stories.description: Iran retaliated by launching drones and later firing waves of ballistic missiles at Israel, where explosions lit the night skies over Jerusalem and Tel Aviv and shook the buildings below
